`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. The `cli` module compiles and its tests pass offline. I did not run the CLI itself, so the help output and the overview listing are checked by reading the code, not by running it.

Changes, all in `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/`:
- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` and its description (landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`). Added it to `usageInfo()` with the same landscape options, so it appears in the no-argument overview.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**:
  - `run` dispatches both names to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method, so the behaviour is shared.
  - The help branch prints `args[0]` as the command name, so `analyzeLandscape -help` shows its own name and the analyze description, while `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.

Not done: the README has no command descriptions (it only mentions `init` and the build), so there was nothing to update. I did not add a new section; say if you want one.
